backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping Valentine reveal-related features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality of various frontend components, screens, hooks, and config files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining OKLCH color tokens, theming variables, and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring PWA metadata, icons, and mounting the main React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining metadata, theme colors, icons, and launch behavior for the Valentine Week app.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with romantic styling and a reconnect button.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker handling caching, offline fallback routing, cache cleanup, and notification click behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app state machine controlling login, prompt, week overview, and day detail views with persisted auth state.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Fixed header displaying the app title and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App layout wrapper providing optional romantic gradient and background image layers.
frontend/src/components/Romantic3DReveal: Animated 3D emoji reveal component that shows flowers, gifts, and hearts during day reveal sequences with reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/components/RomanticDecorati: Creates floating romantic emoji decorations and optional confetti with density and burst modes.
frontend/src/components/RomanticScene.ts: Renders a canvas-based animated particle scene with floating hearts and sparkles.
frontend/src/config/valentineWeek.ts: Defines Valentine Week day metadata and provides a helper to fetch a day's content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Returns a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, state management, and context for authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects the user's reduced‑motion preference via a media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useValentineNotificat: Manages Valentine Week notifications, permission handling, and daily reminder scheduling.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global styles, romantic color themes, and custom animations using Tailwind CSS.
frontend/src/lib/dateLock.ts: Provides utilities to check if a day is unlocked, format unlock dates, find the next unlock, and calculate days remaining.
frontend/src/lib/evasiveMotion.ts: Calculates evasive button movement and generates random positions within bounds.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/screens/DayDetailScreen.tsx: Displays detailed content for a selected day with unlock logic and reveal animations.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Implements a password-based login screen with stateful validation and themed visuals.
frontend/src/screens/ValentinePromptScre: Shows a valentine prompt where the 'no' button moves evasively and acceptance triggers confetti.
Renders the week overview grid, handles day selection, and manages notification permissions.
frontend/src/state/authStorage.ts: Manages auth state persistence in localStorage with getters, setters, and clearing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, plugins, colors, and animations for the project.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s PWA-focused Valentine-week app requirements, including login gating, date-locked content, daily notifications, and romantic animations. Also lists existing features, architectural notes, and versioned project state metadata.
